chunks: Amir ibn Abdullah ibn Jud'ah narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"No servant recites the end of Surah Al-Kahf when he sleeps, except that he wakes up at the hour he desires."
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting the end of Surah Al-Kahf before sleeping?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the spiritual discipline of reciting the conclusion of Surah Al-Kahf before sleep, linking it to the divine gift of waking at a predetermined, auspicious hour. This practice is often interpreted by Shia scholars as a means of securing *barakah* in one’s rest and aligning one’s consciousness with divine will upon awakening, reflecting the Surah’s themes of guidance and protection from tribulation.
